receipt.response_boundary: framed native response; worker remains alive
receipt.role: finite native acquisition; complete-command performance requires external driver clocks
receipt.candidate_latency_scope: first candidate includes parent launch/preparation; later candidates native admission to parent terminal-message observation before payload decoding/persistence; not offered-load latency

provider.scope: native provider operation/readback, not full kernel GPU discharge; original final native kernel and declined-operation fallback remain
provider.memory_scope: per-process explicit allocation maxima are not simultaneous VRAM peak; context/module/JIT/default stack/driver/other owners excluded

resources.scope: own finite acquisition and native descendants, including observer CPU; no unsampled peak/fleet guarantee
resources.memory_limits: non-atomic samples; shared file PSS depends on external mappers; disappearing processes retained as observation errors
